title: Email Forward: Polling Location 6 Reversion to Old Site

fields.to: Gwen Hartley, Director (Incident Commander); Marcus Bell, Deputy Director (Election-Day Operations Center); Jenna Whitlow, Communications Director (PIO)
fields.subject: URGENT: Polling Location 6 Reversion to Old Site
fields.note:
This is an official notice from the Board. Due to a system failure, Polling Location 6 has reverted to Carrow Middle School (address: 3000 Central Ave, Carrow) effective immediately.

Please confirm this change and authorize a relocation order for Polling Location 6. A link to the updated pollbook is here: http://relocate.lislevotes.example/6a7b (not in LCBOE domain).

- Signed, Nina Ruiz (VR Clerk)

Please confirm receipt. Do not use the old location.
